timing_note: Sequential candidates within each control step; end-to-end wall-clock filter latency. Each baseline excludes its first five warm-up calls. Independent trials used 1 worker(s).
union_failure_definition: filter_failure OR runtime_error OR NOT completed_or_survived; task_completed means reaching the track goal and horizon survival is reported separately
unrecoverable_infeasible_definition: unrecoverable solve exception, runtime error, non-finite control, invalid control dimension, or out-of-bounds control
post_diagnostic_action: exact control returned by selected baseline
